answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose a grey-box framework that generates high quality textual adversarial examples

answer_2.quote: In addition to measuring how well the adversarial examples fool the sentiment classifier, we also use a number of automatic metrics to assess other aspects of adversarial examples, following : Attacking performance. ... Similarity. ... Fluency. ... Transferability. ... Attacking speed.

answer_4.quote: To validate that these metrics work, we conduct a crowdsourcing experiment on Appen. ... We ask crowdworkers the following questions
answer_4.guideline: 1. Is snippet B a good paraphrase of snippet A? Yes Somewhat yes No 2. How natural does the text read? Very unnatural Somewhat natural Natural 3. What is the sentiment of the text? Positive Negative Cannot tell
